name: Mrs Mallow, Feeding Them Up
text: End of Turn: your smallest unit gains +1/+1.
golden_text: End of Turn: your smallest unit gains +2/+2.
details: Smallest means Attack plus Health. Skip Shy units. Ties go to the earlier slot in the zigzag F1-B1-F2-B2-F3-B3-F4. This can choose itself.

source.note: Pass 2 review calls in DECISIONS.md take precedence.
